original: Unfortunately, many English learners believe they should remain silent until their English becomes perfect. This belief often prevents them from making progress. Language experts agree that mistakes are a natural part of learning. Every conversation provides an opportunity to improve vocabulary, pronunciation, and confidence.
correction: Unfortunately, many English learners believe they should remain silent until their English becomes perfect. Waiting for perfection can keep you out of the conversations you need for practice. When you speak, notice what helps your listener understand you, ask for feedback, and try again. A mistake can become something useful to work on.
reason: Replace a vague appeal to language experts with concrete, learner-facing practice advice.

original: Another important aspect of goal setting is flexibility. Sometimes life does not go according to plan. Unexpected challenges may require us to adjust our strategy, but we should not abandon our goal completely. Successful people review their progress regularly, learn from mistakes, and continue moving forward.
correction: Another important aspect of goal setting is flexibility. Sometimes life does not go according to plan. You may need to adjust your strategy, reduce the size of a task, or reconsider the goal itself. Changing a goal is not always the same as giving up. Review your progress, learn from setbacks, and decide which next step is realistic for your circumstances.
reason: Avoid teaching persistence as an absolute obligation when goals or circumstances legitimately change.

original: Researchers have found that writing down goals increases the likelihood of achieving them. People who write their goals often think more carefully about their plans and are more committed to taking action. Sharing goals with supportive friends, teachers, or family members can also provide encouragement and accountability.
correction: Writing down a goal gives you something concrete to review. Note what you want to do, how you will practise, and when you will check your progress. Sharing the plan with a supportive friend, teacher, or family member can help you stay accountable.
reason: Replace an unidentified research claim with transparent practical advice; do not invent a study citation.

original: For many years, intelligence was measured mainly by IQ, or Intelligence Quotient. People believed that academic knowledge and logical reasoning were the most reliable predictors of success. However, research over the past few decades has challenged this assumption by highlighting another essential quality: emotional intelligence.
correction: IQ tests assess some cognitive abilities, but they do not describe every skill people use in daily life. A person may solve complex problems yet struggle to listen, handle frustration, or work with others. Emotional intelligence provides a way to discuss how people understand emotions and respond to them.
reason: Remove the unsupported historical/predictive comparison between IQ and emotional intelligence.

original: Psychologist Daniel Goleman popularized the concept of emotional intelligence by identifying five essential components: self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills. Self-awareness allows people to recognize their emotional state and understand how their feelings influence their behavior. Self-regulation enables them to control emotional reactions instead of acting impulsively. Motivation encourages people to pursue long-term goals despite setbacks. Empathy involves understanding the feelings and perspectives of others, while social skills help individuals communicate effectively and build meaningful relationships.
correction: In the model popularized by psychologist Daniel Goleman, emotional intelligence includes five components: self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills. Self-awareness allows people to recognize their emotional state and understand how their feelings influence their behavior. Self-regulation enables them to control emotional reactions instead of acting impulsively. Motivation encourages people to pursue long-term goals despite setbacks. Empathy involves understanding the feelings and perspectives of others, while social skills help individuals communicate effectively and build meaningful relationships.
reason: Attribute the five-part model without presenting it as the only universally established definition.
